headline: European Automakers Urge EU to Protect Türkiye Operations Under New Rules
summary: The European Automobile Manufacturers’ Association called for targeted exemptions to protect carmakers' investments in Türkiye under proposed 'Made in EU' rules. The ACEA warned that exclusion could weaken European competitiveness.
why: Türkiye is a major manufacturing and export hub for European automakers, operating under a customs union with the European Union.

impacts.name: Automotive
impacts.why: Trade exemptions would preserve Turkish manufacturing access to the European single market.
